It may have lost its speedy properties, but at least it tastes good now.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Toasty Rushrooms are a type of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] can make Toasty Rushrooms by burning [[Rushroom]]s with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Though the special speed-boosting abilities of Rushrooms are lost in the process of roasting, their taste is improved. They restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to [[Link]] when eaten. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Toasty Rushrooms reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Rushroom]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. The process of creating Toasty Rushrooms improves their taste, although they lose their speed-boosting effects. When [[Link]] eats a Toasty Rushroom, will be healed by three-quarters of a [[Heart]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Roasted Food * Rushroom }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
